worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.summary: Spray a jet of strange steam at a chosen point, where it blooms into a low cloud: the first enemy caught in it is scalded and may be left confused; anyone who stays inside keeps being seared and has the confusion renewed.
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.use.0: Seal a landing point or a doorway
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.use.2: Keep pressuring whoever enters or leaves with a lingering cloud
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.descripti: When the cloud first catches an enemy it scalds them for about %1$s special damage; the cloud has a radius of %2$s blocks and the jet reaches %3$s blocks, with the ground disc marking the cloud's area.

The cloud lingers %2$s and covers up to %3$s enemies at once; an enemy that stays inside is seared for about %1$s special damage about every 3 seconds, renewing the confusion. The cloud disperses early if the caster falls or moves too far away.
On being sprayed, %1$s chance to leave the target confused for %2$s; each action it starts then has %3$s chance to be broken.
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.dense.on: Dense: a bigger, longer cloud with a higher chance and longer confusion, at the cost of a lower first-spray hit - good for sealing routes and sustained pressure.
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.dense.off: Erupt: a smaller, shorter cloud with a sharper first spray, at the cost of area and duration - good for a hit-and-run.
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.growth.0: From level %1$s the first-spray power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.growth.1: From level %1$s the first-spray power rises to %2$s, the confuse chance to %3$s and the cloud duration to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.strangesteam.preferenc: On: a bigger, longer cloud with a higher chance and longer confusion, but the first spray is x0.85 - good for sealing routes. Off (Erupt): a smaller, shorter cloud with a x1.12 sharper first spray, at the cost of area and duration.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; higher means it sprays earlier.
On: a target with other enemies around it ranks higher, since one cloud catches several; off: normal ranged-attack ordering.
On: lower-health targets rank higher for the first spray; off: all targets rank alike.
